subtitle: Lesson 4 · Surviving the Failures That Are Guaranteed

code:
Single region @ 99.9% uptime:
   525.6 minutes of downtime / year

Two independent regions, active-active:
   99.9999% uptime
   0.526 minutes of downtime / year
caption: The same two regions, each no better than before -- combined, under a minute a year.

eyebrow: ...as long as one thing is true
code:
AS LONG AS their failures are genuinely independent.

Shared model API provider, shared auth service,
shared cloud billing account --

one shared dependency takes BOTH regions down at once.
caption: Real HA design removes shared dependencies, not just stands up a second region.
